description: Equal-weight empirical 1-D Wasserstein-1 distance via mean absolute sorted-rank differences, derived from Vallander (English translation, pp. 784-786, Eq. (2)); reduction and option validation conventions follow src/topologies/implementations/losses/multi_similarity.py:7-15,100-105.

examples.title: Train a scalar regressor with empirical Wasserstein-1

name: Equal-weight 1-D Wasserstein-1 loss

parameters.**params: unsupported; any extra parameter raises ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because ignored-index semantics are undefined for real-valued samples
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite real-valued tensor with shape [N], where N is at least 1
parameters.reduction: none returns sorted rankwise absolute gaps, mean returns Wasserstein-1, or sum returns the total gap (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite real-valued tensor with shape [N], matching logits_or_prediction
